title: A walk can shortcut its repeats
hook: A walk can visit everything while taking avoidable detours.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Offline optimum versus online decisions; cost and approximation ratio.
doesNotKnow: Build a metric TSP tour from an MST walk and shortcut repeated vertices using the triangle inequality.

misconception: Removing repeated stops can make a metric route longer.
objective: Build a metric TSP tour from an MST walk and shortcut repeated vertices using the triangle inequality.

claims.text: Doubling a tree provides a closed walk through every vertex. Skipping repeat vertices replaces subpaths with direct metric edges, which cannot be longer by the triangle inequality. The walk and shortcut lengths stay visible alongside the MST lower bound.
